scope: Frontend cold-start recovery; no hosting plan or backend changes

browser_verification.tool: Playwright CLI against the local production build with intercepted synthetic API responses
browser_verification.automatic_recovery: Six transient gateway responses, including HTML HTTP 200, then healthy readiness and unauthenticated session; sign-in enabled automatically on the seventh health request
browser_verification.outage: Readiness deadline displays Retry connection and keeps authentication disabled
browser_verification.deadline_testing: Browser startup deadline accelerated to eight seconds; full two-minute retry deadline separately verified with a controlled clock in API tests
browser_verification.form_preservation: Email, password, and registration full name survive a connection retry
browser_verification.lost_login_response: One login write returning 502; reconnect restores its resulting session without replaying credentials; session also restores on reload
browser_verification.mobile: 390px width, no horizontal overflow; outage screenshot visually reviewed
browser_verification.accessibility: Zero axe WCAG 2 A/AA and WCAG 2.1 AA violations in waking, unavailable, and recovered registration states

limits: Browser fault scenarios use mocked API responses, not a forced restart of live services.
No real account was created and no model call was made.
The unchanged backend and complete existing browser workflow suite remain covered by GitHub CI; they were not rerun locally for this frontend-only fix.
Render free-service sleep still applies, including the delay before the frontend can return HTML.
Deployment of this source change has not been verified by this pre-push record.
